prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. "Pumpwerk Sieben", a dark gigantic underground pumping station hall deep below the city sewers, seen from above. Dim red emergency lighting everywhere, rusty steel, wet concrete, steam. The walkable area is made of wide flat rusty iron grating floors and riveted steel catwalks with thin railings: a long horizontal catwalk across the upper part of the image from the left edge to the right, a broad grating platform down the whole left side, and a long lower catwalk along the bottom; puddles and grates mirror red and faint cyan light.
TOP LEFT TO TOP CENTER, along the top wall: three colossal pump wheels in a row, each a huge rusty red iron wheel with thick spokes standing half sunk in its own dark pit behind a railing, with giant axles and flywheels, pipes as thick as houses running up from them - the most eye-catching sight of the map.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT, right of the third wheel: a valve control stand on a small raised platform - an old console with many red hand wheels, levers, round gauges and a dangling logbook clipboard, lit by a caged red lamp.
TOP RIGHT CORNER: a clean, out-of-place research outpost of three stacked glossy white shipping containers with rounded corners, cold white floodlights, a little white fence, an outdoor computer terminal with a glowing cyan screen (no text) and a sealed container door; the white floor plate in front of them is walkable. It is connected to the main catwalk only through a narrow bottleneck passage squeezed between a huge pipe and the shaft edge.
CENTER: a huge square open shaft in the middle of the hall, a deep black abyss with dark water glinting far below, fenced by railings; a single walkable pipe bridge - a fat horizontal pipe with a flat grating walkway on top and thin handrails - crosses the shaft vertically from the upper catwalk down to the lower catwalk, slightly left of center.
RIGHT SIDE below the outpost: a tangle of gigantic rusty pipes and pumps filling the right edge (blocking).
BOTTOM LEFT: a hidden alcove behind hanging plastic curtains - a makeshift back-alley surgery niche with an operating table under a big round surgical lamp, a rolling tray of tools, cool boxes, red emergency light and a lone green glow.
BOTTOM CENTER: a small dead-end alcove full of tangled cables and broken chips where tiny glittering crystals sparkle on the floor (a nest of cable salamanders, but draw no animals).
BOTTOM CENTER-RIGHT, on the lower catwalk: a small old auxiliary pump with a crank.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the giant mouth of an overflow pipe, as big as a house, opening at the right edge, closed by a round iron grate with a big rusty hand wheel in its center, a trickle of water on the floor.
Pipes along the walls, cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor, a few warning stripes, small glowing green mushrooms in corners.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: LEFT edge (west) - a dark round tunnel opening with a dim lamp leading back to the sewer collector; RIGHT edge bottom - the huge overflow pipe mouth with the hand wheel.
Time: always night underground, damp, lit mainly by red emergency lights, the cold white light of the outpost and faint glow.
